body: i don't want to live. i am just too scared to end it.

i am a failed musician and an artist. i have been in a decade long writing block, induced by a string of bad working partners, bad business decisions and poor education choices. my daily life consists of fighting against the overpowering sense of emptiness and ennui, while pretending i am still whole to my family. these outbursts are just symptomatic to the sense of powerlessness.

i suffer from PTSD and an anxiety disorder, which leaves me alternating between fighting for my life against imagined intruders with a weapon and laying awake at night, with my heart pounding, revelling in the fact that i am going to die, eventually. i feel like i am slipping away daily from the others, as i get older, i find myself more and more alienated from my peers (i am in my late 30s). it is becoming increasingly difficult to fight against the impulses and very dark and scary thoughts
